groups.root_cause: v2 (ADR-0002/D2) deletes the plugin-cache self-heal loop outright; the upstream trigger (CC auto-update leaves a stale plugin-cache path) is unresolved unless the fix moves to install/update time
groups.evidence: d08fe6a6/8d840973 introduced the 4-layer self-heal for anthropics/claude-code#46915; fb55ed03 and a342dd54/2965d246 show the heal logic itself caused 3 further bugs before #1215/#1191 were filed. ADR-0010 replaces heal with manual `ctx doctor`, which is a straight regression to the original 2026 upstream bug unless the check also runs automatically once per update.

edits.change: State that install/update runs the plugin-cache-path check once automatically (not only on manual `ctx doctor`), to prevent the original upstream CC auto-update bug from recurring silently.
Add contract test: after a simulated CC auto-update that leaves a stale plugin-cache path, next install/update detects and fixes it without a manual doctor run.

groups.root_cause: Pi adapter has no system-role hook path; SessionStart/injection carrier for hint lines is unresolved and blocked on open question Q3
groups.evidence: map-I0.md's own 'New decisions needed' section still lists Q3 (dual plugin+MCP registration ownership) unresolved; no r2/r4 outcome file answers it. No cm-main commit sets role=system for Pi injection (grep for 'system role' and '#1264': no hits).

edits.change: Mark wont-fix-for-v2.0 with note: blocked on unanswered Q3 (map-I0.md); escalate to owner before any Pi system-role carrier work starts.

groups.root_cause: New adapter/capability requests with no prior code history, out of initial v2.0 scope per D14
groups.evidence: No commit found for DeepSeek Harness or Devin CLI adapters in cm-main. D14 treats new adapters as separate scope from v2.0 GA.

edits.change: Add a 'deferred (post-GA)' note for DeepSeek Harness and Devin CLI, citing D14, instead of silently omitting them.

groups.root_cause: Process lifecycle: hosts (OpenCode/KiloCode) that never emit stdin EOF or change ppid can hang/accumulate; existing GP9 scope and timeout model (Q8) don't cover the whole handler
groups.evidence: ac11f103 added an idle-shutdown timer for exactly this host class; a888cac6 reverted it 4 months later because it broke tool availability on 12 hosts. eea5877b fixed #406 by removing a blanket exec timeout. DECISIONS-r3 Q8 answers the model (fixed, measured timeout + process-tree kill) but TECH-SPEC GP9's issue list omits #999 and GP4 does not state the timeout wraps ctx_batch_execute's indexing/search step.

edits.change: Add #999 to GP9's issue list; add explicit case for hosts with no stdin-EOF/ppid-change signal, asserting process-tree kill via Q8's timeout model only (no bare idle-timer, per a888cac6 revert history).
Add case: ctx_batch_execute with timeout=5000ms and huge-output command — total handler time (exec+index+search) stays within timeout+margin.

groups.root_cause: runPool concurrency-cap flag can be wrong when jobs < concurrency
groups.evidence: runPool moved in 5bb1b0f2 (flatten) and gained opt-in parallelism in b392c2fe; no commit fixes the capped-flag bug itself.

edits.change: Add unit test asserting capped === (jobs >= concurrency) before porting runPool to v2.

groups.root_cause: session_events ranking tuned repeatedly without a stable rule (D12 already OPEN)
groups.evidence: 604aba98, 837b8824, 9e29a940 show repeated ranking tuning. map-I3.md already flags D12 OPEN and the P2-vs-#874 contradiction; these rows add no new finding.

edits.change: No new action; leave D12 flagged OPEN as-is, note #895/#874 are duplicates of the already-tracked contradiction, not new issues.

groups.root_cause: Uninstall scope must match v1's full audit (hooks/settings + cache dir + stop running MCP server)
groups.evidence: 13afc854 'fix(setup): 15-platform completeness' is v1's uninstall-no-op fix baseline; DECISIONS-r3.md does not yet nail down cache-dir removal or server-stop for v2 `ctx uninstall`.

edits.change: State ctx uninstall must cover (a) hooks/settings per adapter, (b) cache dir removal, (c) stop the running MCP server, citing 13afc854 as the no-regression bar; add matching contract test.

groups.root_cause: ctx_resume byte budget (2 KB) lacks a named GP test id, same gap as the code-echo default question
groups.evidence: DECISIONS-r3 Q2 states the 2 KB ctx_resume cap is distinct from the global 16,384 B cap, but no GP test row pins it the way GP3/GP4 pin the global cap.

edits.change: Add a GP row for the 2 KB ctx_resume cap, mirroring GP4's shape; keep code-echo off by default per r3 (#1047), same test covers both.

groups.root_cause: r3 flipped #1032 to closed-by-design with no basis citation; the actual VS Code/Codex Remote-WSL project-source mechanism is still unnamed outside one ADR line
groups.evidence: ADR-0007 §Q11 (docs/v2/adr/0007-mcp-2026-07-28.md:74) commits to 'one named project source per host; doctor reports a missing source; no fallback chain' but names no mechanism for VS Code Remote-WSL. r3's basis column is '-' (no citation).

edits.change: Name the mechanism explicitly: ${workspaceFolder} launch arg as the one named source for VS Code Remote-WSL, no fallback, matching the no-fallback-chain owner rule.
Add case pinning ${workspaceFolder} resolution for VS Code Remote-WSL.

groups.root_cause: Genuinely new edge-case gaps surfaced by external PRs, no v1 regression history (class B contract-test candidates)
groups.evidence: No cm-main commit matches Unicode tokenizer boundaries (#1295), globstar zero-depth matching (#1291), or JSONC comment-vs-string detection (#1271); all are fresh gaps, not regressions.

edits.change: Add 3 contract tests: non-ASCII auto-memory search tokenization (#1295); ** zero-directory glob match (#1291); real JSONC tokenizer, not line-based // strip, for config edits (#1271) — satisfies the no-regex-as-reduction-mechanism rule.

groups.root_cause: Native dependency install-retry logic is moot once D2 removes runtime installs (deps bundled)
groups.evidence: D2: no runtime installs, deps bundled. #1278's bounded-retry/hidden-console fix targets ensure-deps.mjs's native install step, which D2 removes entirely.

edits.change: Note #1278/#1281/#1253 are moot under D2 (no native install step remains to retry); no v2 action needed.

groups.root_cause: Per-adapter generalization gaps: hardcoded single-tool/single-schema assumptions instead of a reviewed allow-list or per-adapter conformance check
groups.evidence: No commit found for PowerShell routing, antigravity Stop-hook schema, or install-must-not-remove-user-hooks — all are gaps in generalizing one adapter's assumption to all 10 agents.

edits.change: Add: (a) shell-tool allow-list reviewed per new adapter (#1212); (b) per-adapter hooks.json schema-conformance test, not just claude-code's schema (#1240); (c) install/upgrade must preserve pre-existing user hooks (#1235).

groups.root_cause: Bun removal (D2) fixes the spin/CPU half of the Pi-bridge bug but the single-writer-per-file race (D3) needs its own independent proof
groups.evidence: Bun is a removed runtime across ADR-0016, ADR-0008 r3, ADR-0007; no commit independently demonstrates the shared-writer race is fixed by D3 alone.

edits.change: Split #1205 into two tests: (1) process never spawns Bun; (2) single-writer-per-file invariant (D3) holds under concurrent Pi-bridge writes.

groups.root_cause: D8 (hooks write to caller's journal; server never writes) must reuse #645's explicit per-caller DB-path resolution, not a new heuristic
groups.evidence: #645 already introduced an explicit resolveSessionDbPath-style per-caller resolution function; D8's implementation must call that same function.

edits.change: Require D8 to call #645's resolution function; add GP case: two concurrent sessions writing ctx_* events simultaneously, each credited to its own session id, not 'latest'.

groups.root_cause: Content-store retention rule undecided between age-since-last-access and content-hash dedup
groups.evidence: Matches the live-PID exemption pattern already used for #1140/#1143 (session DB TTL keys off last activity, not creation time, per 939c5ca8's lineage).

edits.change: Adopt age-since-last-access retention, exempting rows touched by a still-open session, mirroring the #1140/#1143 live-PID rule.

groups.root_cause: Pi bridge bootstrap retry is one-shot per session (#813's original design); a failed tools/list on one turn stays failed for the rest of the session
groups.evidence: 5c18c673 (lazy bootstrap), bebc7529 (keep bridge alive, route diagnostics off TUI), 77e22a46 (reap idle children) — none retries a failed tools/list on the next turn; #813's lazy-bootstrap was intentionally one-shot.

edits.change: Make bootstrap retryable per-turn, not per-session; add contract test: next before_agent_start after a failed tools/list re-runs bootstrap.

groups.root_cause: Pi system-prompt injection (D9) must be byte-identical across requests in a turn, not merely relocated out of systemPrompt
groups.evidence: 4ced18cb moved injection out of systemPrompt into a context hook to preserve prompt-cache prefix; #1112 shows the ephemeral tail injection still breaks the cache because content, not just location, varies.

edits.change: Require injected bytes to be CONSTANT per turn (not just relocated); GP2 asserts byte-stable prefix across requests.

groups.root_cause: Pi adapter rendering bug lumped into a generic #1135 bucket with no named GP case
groups.evidence: r2 line 129 groups #1150 with #1135 generically; no GP case named for either, though they are different adapters/bugs.

edits.change: Split #1150 out of the shared #1135 bucket; assign GP5 with assertion: call row shows language + first code line.

groups.root_cause: Windows cold-start PATH-probe latency has no dedicated test; risks being folded into the unrelated S-NODE (Node-version) spike
groups.evidence: No git history for the 30s Windows PATH-probe fix; S-NODE answers a different question (minimum Node version), not startup latency.

edits.change: Add explicit GP case: reply < 1s on cold start with no PATH probes, kept separate from S-NODE.

groups.root_cause: ctx_execute has no defined cancel/abort behavior for the spawned child process tree
groups.evidence: No git history found for ctx_execute abort/Esc handling; untested in all review files read.

edits.change: Add GP case: start a long ctx_execute, send cancel, assert child process tree is gone within 1s and a cancel reply is returned.

groups.root_cause: Headless Claude Code may run a dead/duplicate formatter path that D7's single hooks.json generation doesn't explicitly test
groups.evidence: D7 ('one TS hook path, no dead copies') is the structural fix candidate but no headless-mode test confirms it; no ADR names #979 directly.

edits.change: Add a headless-mode GP case alongside the existing D7 hooks.json generation test.

groups.root_cause: ctx_fetch_and_index error format on unreachable URLs is unspecified (full Node stack vs one-line cause)
groups.evidence: No ADR or TECH-SPEC sets the format; this is a format rule, not truncation, so it does not conflict with the no-truncation-as-reduction-mechanism owner rule.

edits.change: Return only the one-line error cause (strip Node stack) on unreachable URLs, for consistency across tools.

groups.root_cause: Crash/data-loss fixes (session TTL keyed off last activity, not start time) conflict with D1's 1.x security-fix-only merge rule
groups.evidence: 939c5ca8 fixed the PID-liveness + age TTL bug this class belongs to; D1 restricts 1.x merges to security fixes. Per the owner's 'v1 unit tests stay until v2 passes KEEP-PASS' and 'hard deny v1 scope with its issues fixed' rules, crash/data-loss fixes land in v2 only — D1 is not widened without explicit new owner input.

edits.change: Note #1143/#1160/#1176/#1177/#1207/#1138/#1180/#1154 stay unmerged in 1.x under D1 as written; they land only in v2. Keep tests/session/cleanup-preserves-active-sessions.test.ts in the v2 KEEP-PASS set so this exact bug cannot silently return.

groups.root_cause: Test-portability claim (no /bin/bash hardcode) asserted by title only, not verified by CI
groups.evidence: No commit or -S hit found for a /bin/bash hardcode in test files; keyword search only hit unrelated ADR docs commits.

edits.change: Add a CI check confirming the v2 test harness does not hardcode /bin/bash; only then treat #972 as verified-safe.

groups.root_cause: ctx_forget tool is not yet placed in the consolidated 10-agent tool set
groups.evidence: No commit found adding or discussing ctx_forget; genuinely undecided with no history, and the owner's fixed tool-set scope (10 agents, one shared context.db) does not currently list it.

edits.change: Leave ctx_forget out of the v2.0 tool set; revisit only on explicit owner request.

groups.root_cause: Pi has no way to surface the Read/Grep hint via hook stdout, since Pi never sees hook output
groups.evidence: git log --all --grep='#1069' is empty in cm-main; r2 already flags this as needs-decision, recommending the test target tool-description text instead of hook stdout.

edits.change: Assert the hint appears in the tool description text (host-agnostic), not hook stdout, since Pi never receives hook output.
